headline: Human Written
windows: Most sober people don't feel much from zeolite, but when the trip is toxic or the gut is driving it, the effect is easy to feel. I put a spoonful of zeolite into a cup of water or juice and sip slowly (some people need a teaspoon, others a tablespoon).
Rubbing the zeolite on the body or just holding its jar also helps me. In my experiments, zeolite has to be prepared correctly.
I use powdered zeolite rather than nano-liquid zeolite. Many products did nothing for me, I think because most zeolites have clogged pores that haven't been cleaned, but ZeoCharge is sold as cleaned.
